messages:
sam.sales: Arcadia Finance submitted a SIG/CAIQ (~180 questions) and requested SOC2 report + attestation. Procurement needs answers by Thu COB. They require EU-only data residency, SAML SSO metadata, and a list of subcontractors. Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SR-9845 — please assign an owner.
nina.security: I'm taking app/auth controls and SSO. Adding to intake and will do preliminary triage.
omar.security: I'll handle infra/network, pen-test evidence, and vendor access controls. Flagging anything that needs operational proofs.
raj.eng: We can generate SAML metadata and an SSO sequence diagram. Network peering/VPC questions will need follow-up — tagging as "eng required".
liz.legal: looping legal for DPA/addendum and subcontractor review. If they insist on FedRAMP controls we need to escalate to compliance.
sig-bot: New intake created: SR-9845 \u2014 assigned to security intake. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SR-9845 :white_check_mark:
sam.sales: Procurement contact: secproc@arcadia.com. They also want a third-party pentest report within last 12 months and evidence of SOC2 Type II.
omar.security: we have a 2025-11 pentest; will attach a redacted copy to the shared drive. Marking pentest Qs as "evidence attached" where applicable.
nina.security: Triage summary: high risk 3 remote support & admin shells; medium 3 external subcontractor access; data residency is a blocker for EU-only requirement. Will map H/M/L in tracker.
raj.eng: SAML snippet for reference (non-sensitive example):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
liz.legal: we'll prepare a limited disclosure note and a DPA addendum draft. Marking ~7 questions as "legal review".
alex.custsuc: CS note 3 POC starts in two weeks; customer may require signed attestation and SOC2 before environment access. Coordinate with me.
nina.security: created tracker row: ArcadiaFinance | SIG | Owners: Nina,Omar | Due: 2026-04-02 | Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/arcadia-sig-tracker
sam.sales: I'll confirm whether Arcadia accepts redacted pentest + SOC2 summary or needs full reports. Will update ticket and procurement contact.
omar.security: after eng/legal inputs, I'll move ticket to "answered - pending customer review" and create Jira subtasks for evidence handoff.
nina.security: closing intake thread here and opening a focused closeout thread for completing the CAIQ/Q&A.
